Maya (Docs): Drafting internal announce + release notes for v2.16.0. Change window tonight 23:45 UTC. Need quick signoff on rollback wording, deploybot flags, and the 'what to test' section.
Sam (Eng): Plan is canary 5% -> 25% -> full over 45m. Rollback: restore model tag r2.15.4 and drain new pool. Runbook will include exact command.
Lee (Runtime): Add explicit alert thresholds to notes: p95 > 550ms for 10m OR 5xx > 0.8% => auto-rollback. Also include modelctl command in runbook.
Maya (Docs): Proposed rollback sentence: "If release health crosses thresholds, the platform will automatically pin back to r2.15.4 and scale the previous pool; ops-oncall will be notified." Good?
Sam (Eng): Yes. Deploybot command I'll schedule:
```
/deploy rollout v2.16.0 --canary=5% --watch=45m --metric-p95=550ms --metric-errors-10m=0.8% --on-failure=auto-rollback
```
ops-oncall: EU/US windows OK. I'll be oncall and will escalate to #incidents if auto-rollback triggers. Add me to watchers.
Priya (QA): QA checklist added to notes: 1) smoke gen @ 512 tokens, 2) embedding compare vs golden set, 3) long-context stability @ 1024 tokens, 4) sanity sampling on high-temp prompts. Will run staging at 23:15.
Jules (Product): Add a short line for Dedicated customers: "Dedicated clusters may observe transient batching changes; Solutions Eng should coordinate with high-SLA customers."
Maya (Docs): Added product line and lock target 23:00 UTC. I'll post internal announcement at 23:05 UTC to #eng-releases + company-wide channel. Please reply with :+1: if good to go.
Sam (Eng): +1
Lee (Runtime): +1
ops-oncall: +1
Priya (QA): +1 - staging smoke will post results here.
deploy-bot: scheduled by @sam  job 100111 scheduled: rollout v2.16.0 at 23:45 UTC (canary 5%). Watchers: ops-oncall, Sam (Eng).
Maya (Docs): Thanks all. If anything changes before 23:00 ping me here.
